set.alwaysOnTopDesc: When on, the window stays above everything else and will cover other apps. Same switch as the pin button in the title bar
set.densityDesc: Changes spacing only — never font size (Chinese glyphs are pixel-aligned at 12.5px). Standard is identical to before.
set.langDesc: Affects the UI only. Replies and tool output pass through untouched
set.logsDesc: Last {n} lines (extension notices and pi stderr)
set.piBundledMissing: The bundled runtime is missing. Dev: run `npm run vendor:pi`. Installed build: reinstall the app.
set.piShellWarn: Falling back to the shell `pi`; prompts with special characters may break.
set.replayOnboardDesc: Reopen the “Before you start” checklist from first launch (pi / model access / connectivity); does not reset the seen flag
set.sendKeyDesc: How Enter and Ctrl+Enter behave in the composer. "Auto" = Enter sends normally, and inserts a newline in long-form mode (double-tap Up or drag taller). The active rule is always shown in the composer.
set.soundDesc: Alert you when a turn finishes, you are asked to answer, or something errors: play a sound and/or show a system notification when the window is not focused (like opencode's attention)
set.soundEnabledDesc: Master switch. When off, the per-event switches below do nothing
set.soundEventDoneDesc: When a reply completes and the agent stops working
set.soundEventErrorDesc: When the pi process or an extension reports an error
set.soundEventQuestionDesc: When the model or an extension asks you to choose, confirm or type
set.soundNotifyDesc: Shown only when the window is not focused; clicking one brings the window back. Independent from the sound switch
set.soundNotifyTestBody: If you can see this, system notifications work
set.soundVolumeDesc: Releasing the slider previews at the new volume
set.streamWidthDesc: Messages, composer, usage bar and the left navigation rail all share one width; drag to apply instantly
set.themeDesc: Dark is polished; light has full tokens but isn’t fine-tuned
set.title: Settings
set.toolDetailDesc: Off by default: a tool call stays one line — starting, streaming and finishing never expand on their own; click any row to inspect (history always remains readable). On expands only the running call into a terminal window
set.uiScaleDesc: Auto snaps to whole pixels based on your display scaling, so CJK text stays crisp. Also Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0
